facts.fact: Corporal Kandan tells Neela he will give Rema a statement for her roll about the bride learning every man's house and the warden bowing; Neela knows a roll can feed a crown record of her. She chooses not to tell Devan, so Kandan is not moved and made a martyr.

Neela's left hand is bandaged (F475) and her right palm carries a three-day-old scab from the nightbark tree (F492). In ch 10 she works and throws with the right hand; Chinna's ladle strikes her right knuckles and a welt rises on Devan's right knuckles over his old scars.

Neela already knew the eleventh step rings hollow and that she walked wide of the newel since her first week; she told Devan 'I don't know' (F328). Only the file-bright bolts on the grate are new to her, and Janu's matching curve frightens her.
